text:
maria: Heads up — seeing ~8-12% p99 regression on H100 after yesterday's autotune push. Canary shows more Triton -> CUTLASS fallbacks for seqlen=512. :thinking:

aj: Which model + can you paste the probe log? Any kv-cache coldstart spikes?

maria: model=gpt-small-8b, canary id=canary-231. snippets:
```
[router] prefer=triton, probe=seq512, fallback=cutlass, reason=alloc_fail, latency_ms=42, fallback_count=14
[probe] sample_seq=512, success=false, error=CUDA OOM on forward
```

devon: I bet it's KV cache warmup + allocation fragmentation on Triton for larger seqs. We've seen alloc patterns fail when memory gets fragmented after many small seq requests. Probe sampling had too few seq512 samples.

perf-bot: perf-check: throughput drop 9% at batch=8 seq=512 on h100-rt-3. p50 unchanged, p99 up. nvprof snippets point to cudnn_conv slowdown -> wasm? (jk)

aj: Let's avoid rolling back yet. Two suggestions:
- increase probe weight on >=256 seqs
- switch fallback decision to latency-regret (relative) not absolute ms

maria: Repro command:
```
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood/infer' -H 'X-Seq-Length:512' -d @payload.json
```

devon: Proposed router config patch:
```
{"kernel_router": {"probe_window_secs": 600, "seq_buckets": [16,64,256,512,2048], "fallback_hysteresis_ms": 30, "latency_regret_pct": 0.10}}
```

aj: Can we also add a KV-cache warmup policy for long sequences: if request seq>=256 and kv_miss_rate>0.2, prefer CUTLASS for first 3 requests then re-evaluate? :rocket:

maria: Good call. I'll spin a 6h canary with the new probe plan + warmup policy starting now. Rolling back autotune-params for immediate mitigation (deploy-bot rolled this back at 2004123490).

deploy-bot: rollback complete: deploy=autotune-params@2026-03-18T10:04Z

aj: Ping me if p99 stays high after canary. If stable, we'll land the router patch and extend probe sampling to 5% of traffic for >=256.

maria: Will post canary logs to this thread when available. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
